    "Robust reporting capabilities for team accountability.",

    "Scalable features for a growing mid-sized company."

    "Initial setup and customization for enterprise-wide use can be complex.",
    "Cost can become a concern when scaling to multiple teams.",
    "Advanced reporting features sometimes require a deeper learning curve."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The Director of IT likely found Zendesk Suite effective for its primary goal of tracking tickets and holding various teams accountable for usage across the enterprise. While functional, the value for money was a consideration given the scale of implementation within a mid-sized company."
